साउथ के धाकड़ एक्टर Suriya ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर ऐसा धमाका किया है कि सब हैरान रह गए! 🔥

Karuppu और Vishwanath & Sons के बाद पुलिस की वर्दी में लौटे Suriya की नई फिल्म Scene ने advance booking में अपने ही सारे रिकॉर्ड्स तोड़ दिए हैं। पूरे भारत में 6,400 से ज्यादा शोज़ और 173 रुपये की एवरेज टिकट प्राइस के साथ इस फिल्म ने रिलीज से पहले ही 6.41 लाख से अधिक टिकट्स बेच डाले हैं।

कमाई की बात करें तो Scene ने Day 1 advance booking में 11.04 करोड़ gross (9.36 करोड़ net) का शानदार कलेक्शन किया है। इसने Kanguva के 10.16 करोड़ के रिकॉर्ड को पछाड़कर Suriya के करियर की सबसे बड़ी advance booking दर्ज की है, जिसमें सिर्फ उनके होम स्टेट से ही 9.6 करोड़ का कलेक्शन आया है।

अब देखना यह होगा कि क्या Scene अपने 20 करोड़ net के टारगेट को पार करके Kanguva के 24 करोड़ net ओपनिंग के रिकॉर्ड को तोड़ पाएगी? आप इस फिल्म को देखने के लिए कितने एक्साइटेड हैं, कमेंट्स में ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Scene Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (Final): Registers Highest Opening Day Pre-Sales For Suriya!
ctx.summary:
Suriya's Scene raked in impressive numbers in day 1 advance bookings at the Indian box office, crossing 11 crore mark in gross collections. 
 The post  Scene Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (Final): Registers Highest Opening Day Pre-Sales For Suriya!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Scene marks the return of Suriya on the big screen after two money spinners this year: Karuppu and Vishwanath & Sons. As expected, the buzz was there on the ground level, and the fact that it marked the actor’s comeback as a cop after a long time left fans excited. All this was reflected in the day 1 advance bookings at the Indian box office, which turned out to be the actor’s career best.
The latest Tamil dark crime comedy has secured a good showcasing across India. It has been learned that the show count is around 6,400, higher than the opening-day show counts of Karuppu and Vishwanath & Sons. The showcasing is enough to pull off solid numbers on the board. Also, the average ticket price of 173 rupees will help attract more footfall.
As per the final day 1 advance booking update, Scene sold 6.41 lakh tickets (excluding blocked seats) before the first show started. In terms of collections, it has grossed a solid 11.04 crore at the Indian box office through opening-day pre-sales. In net collections, it equals 9.36 crore . Such numbers for a controlled-budget film are impressive, paving the way for a strong start.
With 11.04 crore gross, Scene has registered Suriya’s highest day 1 advance bookings at the Indian box office. It surpassed Kanguva ( 10.16 crore ) to claim the top spot. This clearly indicates that the actor is set for a huge start with his latest biggie. In his home state alone, the film has sold tickets worth 9.6 crore for the first day.
Currently, Kanguva holds the record for the biggest opening in Suriya’s career, with 24 crore net. Given the record advances, the latest Kollywood entertainer is definitely targeting 20 crore net today, and with early reactions in favor, the response through over-the-counter ticket sales will be good as well. Overall, there’s a chance of crossing Kanguva’s 24 crore , scoring the actor’s biggest opening in India. Let’s see how things turn out.
